props.name: hash
props.description: The BlurHash string, usually stored next to the image URL.

props.name: width
props.description: Intrinsic width. With `height`, sets the box's aspect ratio so nothing shifts on load.

props.name: punch
props.description: Contrast of the placeholder. 1 is as encoded; higher is punchier.

props.name: resolution
props.description: Width in pixels the placeholder is decoded at before being scaled up.

props.name: onLoad
props.description: Called once the real image has loaded.
